cellSelection: GnuCash reads text at HTML table positions with sxml->table-row-col (5.17:gnucash/report/test/test-report-extras.scm:96-109): table N of the document; row N counts <tr> elements from 1 (negative from the end), 0 selects the <th> header cells, null every row; column N counts <td> (or <th>) cells from 1 (negative from the right), null every cell. Matching is by descendant, so cells of tables nested in a cell count too, and the result is every text node in document order.
